crossRefs.note: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

Therefore, because you trample on the poor, and take taxes from him of wheat: You have built houses of cut stone, but…
For I know how many your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who…
Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and sell the sweepings with the wheat?’ ”
But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

translations.web: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
translations.bsb: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
translations.kjv: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
translations.asv: The rich ruleth over the poor; And the borrower is servant to the lender.
